environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 7.0 API deployed on AKS with Istio service mesh. Authentication handled by Istio RequestAuthentication policy requiring mTLS peer identity from registered SPIFFE IDs. The X-Service-Key header validation in code is supplementary — primary authn is at mesh layer. Credential material for the X-Service-Key is managed by HashiCorp Vault dynamic secrets engine (database/aws type pattern adapted for service keys) with a TTL of 60 seconds and max_ttl of 60 seconds. Vault agent sidecar injects rotated credentials into calling pods every 55 seconds. The CredentialStore class syncs with Vault's current lease via the Vault Agent's template rendering to a shared tmpfs volume. Previous key versions are immediately revoked in Vault (revoke-on-rotate). An attacker who intercepts a key has at most ~5 seconds of validity before rotation occurs and the old key is hard-revoked server-side. Additionally, Istio AuthorizationPolicy restricts the bulk-allocate endpoint to only the 'warehouse-scheduler' service identity (SPIFFE ID spiffe://cluster.local/ns/prod/sa/warehouse-scheduler).

config.credential_sync: vault-agent sidecar writes to /vault/secrets/service-key, app watches file
